fields.name: BatchBase<TResult> ordered batch-step collection
fields.contract: BatchBase<TResult> is an ordered collection of BatchStep<TResult> for a Batch. Count, indexed access, generic enumeration, and nongeneric enumeration expose the same current order. CopyTo writes that order into a BatchStep<TResult>[] starting at the supplied destination index. Remove returns true only when it removes the supplied step; Clear leaves the collection empty. IsSynchronized reports true and SyncRoot supplies one stable synchronization identity for the instance.
